description: Introduction and overview of the Gato-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Gato class — 77 built — was the U.S. Navy's World War II fleet submarine: 311 feet with ten torpedo tubes and long Pacific range. Gatos strangled Japanese shipping, sinking over a thousand merchant ships. USS Cobia and USS Cod survive as museum ships.
